exposure: Tumor Necrosis Factor inhibitor (TNFi) use during pregnancy
outcome: adverse pregnancy outcomes (low birth weight, (emergency) caesarian section, hypertensive disorders, congenital malformations)
finding: TNFi use during pregnancy in women with well-controlled RA was associated with increased birth weight and not associated with an increase in adverse pregnancy outcomes.
birth_weight: TNFi use: 3.344 kg, No TNFi use: 3.171 kg
